description: Save a video as mp4, webm or mkv, or its audio as mp3, m4a, opus, flac or wav, to a folder on this machine; returns the file paths. Works for YouTube and the other sites yt-dlp supports, and converts local files. Defaults: video mp4 up to 1080p (H.264 + stereo AAC, plays everywhere), audio mp3 at the best VBR quality, with title, cover art and chapters embedded. Keep a part with from/to (seconds or m:ss) or chapter (index or title); cut sponsor reads with removeSegments (YouTube). A playlist or channel URL downloads its first `limit` videos. Files go to dir, else VID2CONTEXT_DOWNLOAD_DIR, else ~/Downloads/vid2context. Download only media you have the rights to: your own uploads, public-domain or Creative Commons works, or videos the site lets you download.

burnSubtitles.description: Burn one language's subtitles into the picture, e.g. "en" (video only; re-encodes, so slower)

chapter.description: Keep one chapter: 0-based index or title (see get_media_options)

dir.description: Folder to save to: absolute, ~/..., or relative to the default folder

embedMetadata.description: Title, channel and date tags. Default true

exactCuts.description: Re-encode at the cut points so a trimmed video starts exactly at from (slower)

format.description: mp4 (default for video), webm, mkv, mp3 (default for audio), m4a, opus, flac, wav

from.description: Start of the part to keep: seconds, m:ss or h:mm:ss

kind.description: video or audio. Default: from format, else video

limit.description: Playlists and channels: how many videos to download. Default 10

quality.description: Video: best, 2160, 1440, 1080, 720, 480, 360, 240, 144 (smaller side in pixels; default 1080). Audio: best, 320, 256, 192, 160, 128, 96, 64 (mp3 kbps; default best)

splitChapters.description: Also save one file per chapter, in a folder next to the full file. Not with from/to/chapter

subtitles.description: Subtitle languages to embed in a video, e.g. ["en"]

to.description: End of the part to keep

url.description: Video, playlist or channel URL, YouTube id, or local file path

name: download_media
title: Download a video or its audio
